items.title: Approve the Minutes of the September 26, 2023 Meeting
Appoint Austin Milford-Rosales as the District 6 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee
Adopt Eight 2023 Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Programs and Amend the Prop L Strategic Plan Baseline
Allocate $13,724,000 and Appropriate $651,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions for Five Requests
Approve San Francisco’s Program of Projects for the 2024 Regional Transportation Improvement Program, with Conditions
Adopt a Resolution Directing The San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency To Incorporate Safe Routes To All Schools in the San Francisco Unified School District In the Active Communities Plan
